rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks which onboarding stages are recorded as complete and whether access, the welcome plan or a progress check comes next. Use the EmployeeOnboardingGuide tool on the sample.
cases.tool_output:
{
  "completed": [
    "Create checklist"
  ],
  "external_work_performed": false,
  "hire": "Contoso sample hire",
  "next_stage": "Provision access",
  "scope": "Design-only checklist; no accounts or messages are created.",
  "stages": [
    "Create checklist",
    "Provision access",
    "Send welcome plan",
    "Check progress"
  ]
}
cases.local_answer:
Using the sample Contoso hire:

**Recorded as complete:** Create checklist

**Next stage:** Provision access

The remaining stages after that are Send welcome plan and then Check progress.

This is a design-only checklist, so no accounts or messages were created.
